en: Color-tinted vintage street view showing a large statue of a man in historical dress on a high pedestal in a European square. The statue stands by a canal, surrounded by stepped-gable houses and cobbled streets. Small groups of people in early 20th‑century clothing walk or stand nearby. At the top of the image, printed text identifies the scene as Bruges and the statue and square of Jean Van Eyck. Additional small text at the bottom notes the editor and location in Brussels.
